title: 第十六章 摄魂鬼盏 蛊魂锁魄第十七章 虫皇问世 力退黑蝠
content_zh:
“摄魂盏”飘在半空，教场内青芒大盛，几乎每个人的眼睛都被吸引过去，一眨不眨。
而那一声叫喊毕竟迟了，鬼灯手法诡异，出手迅捷，“摄魂盏”在他的邪术驱动下，愈发地耀眼夺目。绿光荧荧，竟将教场透射得如宝石一般炫目而妖异！
鬼灯抬眼向下望去，外围的禁卫军已悄悄散去，而教场之上的每个人的眼眸里都灌满了妖异的绿色，并且直勾勾地盯着“摄魂盏”。
鬼灯轻轻一挥动长袖，“摄魂盏”便向他手中飞去，立在掌中。
他伸出枯槁的右手，慢慢探直，直指鬼衣的黑色斗篷。随后他曲起中指，口中默念道：“鬼灯灵物，恩泽圣光，华耀披身，万物莫侵！”
慢慢地，从那件黑衣斗篷上缓缓飘起一点绿色鬼火，紧接着两点，三点，越来越多，冉冉上升，盈盈而动，直向“摄魂盏”汇聚而去！随着最后一点鬼火飘入“摄魂盏”中，鬼灯沉声说道：“出来吧，你没事吧？”
随着鬼灯话音落下，那件黑色斗篷再次恢复了生机，慢慢膨胀起来。黝黝面纱之下，那一双白色大眼如明灯一样霍地一亮，再次燃起！
“‘古剑盟’高手在此，让我颇感意外！若不是你及时出现，祭出‘摄魂盏’，用“鬼火青芒”给我护身，那一剑就差点毙了我！”鬼衣心有余悸。
“那个老不死的太监拖延了我太长时间了！现在所有卫队、禁卫军都撤走了！可以动手了！”鬼灯顿了顿，一指台下呆若木鸡的众人说道：“一个不留？”
“一个不留！”鬼衣冷冷地说道。
群芳楼阁，地底暗道，烛火昏暗。
一个面纱遮掩鼻口，身披卜卦师外衣的人行色匆匆地闯了进来。万青山皱了皱眉头，问道：“发生什么事了？”
“大哥，不出你所料，幽冥鬼府的人正在教场屠杀群雄！”来人气喘不跌地说道。
“那么，我叔父呢，他没事吧？”万青城焦急地问道。“远泊叔，他。。。他已经被鬼衣守卫打死了！”“什么？”万青城一脸难以置信。
“嗳，一将功成万骨枯。这次叔父非死不可！你只需记住今日之仇，日后等你身攀武林之巅，权领四海群雄之时，再报也不迟！”万青山面色漠然地背过身。
而万青城却带着不可思议的眼神瞅了瞅哥哥的背影，他眼神游离，心中思绪澎湃：哥哥还是当年的那个哥哥吗？这十几年江湖的磨砺已经让当初那个善良，懂事，孝顺的哥哥变得如此无情，冷血，阴险！
“那。。。”万青山捋了捋颔下胡须，接着问道：“‘蝶门宗’的人出现了吗？”
“没有。从一开始到现在，压根没出现。”卜卦师摇摇头。
“好吧！”万青山顿了顿，然后牵着万青城的手，踱步走近那位卜卦师。只听他沉声说道：“天佑，‘血煞门’里，你与我关系最好，我走后我弟弟就拜托你了！”
“大哥不必多说，你我在外亡命多年，惺惺相惜，情同手足，而且列位兄弟都十分敬重你，有些话你不必亲自嘱咐的！”天佑眼中含泪，目光灼灼。万青山拍了拍他的肩膀说道：“好兄弟！按计划行事！”

天佑麻利地脱下了卜卦师的外套，递给万青山，然后声音哽咽地说道：“大哥！此一去。。。请你。。。！”话还没说完，天佑的声音已颤抖不止。
万青山双手紧紧扶着他的肩膀，打断了他的话语：“保重！”闻听此言，天佑怔怔地瞅了瞅这位曾与自己同甘共苦的大哥，然后急速回转过头，藏下了眼泪，携着万青城默默地离开。
冰冷的暗道里，只剩下了仙去多日的万锦王，昏迷不醒的虫小蝶，还有双目噙泪的万青山！
“呃！”胸口憋闷的虫小蝶终于吐出了一口气，慢慢爬起，他揉揉惺忪的双眼，向四周打量开去。
地道里并没有什么过多的修饰，只有一个香案，一条棺材，两把藤椅，两抹跳跃不定的烛火。但是，地道里放佛更加阴冷了！洞壁上已经爬满了冰晶，薄薄的一层，就像涂了一层牛乳。而呼吸之间吐出的大团白气，在触碰鼻尖之时会让人感到一丝丝的疼痛。阴冷的地道逗留不住任何暖意，不时有些许冷风卷过，阵阵蚀骨的冰冷就更加泛滥了，甚至可以把整个地道里的空气都给冻结了！
“小鬼头，醒了？”万青山收敛了伤感，冲着虫小蝶诡异地一笑，然后吞吐着长长的舌头，慢吞吞地向虫小蝶走来。
“你是谁？你。。。你要干什么？”那条舌头长似恶鬼，殷红似血，虫小蝶直?的脊背发凉！他哆嗦着、极力向后挪动着身体。
然而，来不及虫小蝶挣扎，万青山已扑了上去，一口咬住了他的脖颈。“哧！”一丝血线直喷了出去。
一股温热如琼浆玉液般灌向万青山的喉咙，他的舌根处传来的阵阵舒爽、曼妙的感觉，那种感觉直递全身！他贪婪地吮吸着，而虫小蝶却无力的扭动着身躯，两个小拳头直抵着万青山的胸口，极力地想推开他。
万青山乃是蝶门宗“黑蝠长老”，因练习“异蝶术”而同“鱼蛇二老”一样变得不人不鬼。他脊椎受损，经血淤塞，必须不定时地吸食人血。“异蝶术”中级奥义，“以身幻物”之时，“鱼蛇二老”炼化的是鱼和蛇。而他炼化的是“黑蝠”，其招数、步法与蝙蝠颇为类似，所以被称之为“黑蝠长老”。
然而，他却没有发觉，刚才的那股血线直接喷到了他放在一旁的锦盒之中，而那锦盒里装的正是“白玉观音”！
那晶莹剔透、寒气缭绕的宝物似乎感受到了血液的温热，嗅到了血液的腥味，竟然慢慢抖动起来，并且“嘶嘶”直叫。而在一旁**万分、忘情吮吸的万青山正享受着处子之血的芬芳，丝毫没有察觉！
“?纭钡匾簧??鞍子窆垡簟币辉径?觯老虺嫘〉砼运踝饕煌诺牧饺巳椿肴徊恢??p>突然虫小蝶感到手背上传来了阵阵蚀骨的冰凉，他不知道那是何物，想扭头去看，可是脖颈处的酸麻疼痛，让他痛苦不堪，根本无暇顾及！
随着血液的流失，虫小蝶的两眼慢慢丧失神光，他的意识也开始模糊、混沌起来。他只知道两件事，自己的血液正源源不断地流入万青山口中，而自己正一步一步地走向死神！他的手无力地耷拉下来，神思游荡在九霄之外。
而在一旁贪婪吮吸的万青山却丝毫没有松口的意思。突然，他感到了一丝不对劲，停顿了下，然后再次俯身吮吸，但是就在这次，当他刚一触及虫小蝶的脖颈之时，突然非常明显地察觉到了一丝怪异的冰凉之气！他皱了皱眉头，继续埋头吮吸，但是奇怪的事情发生了！
万青山猛地发现自己的内力正随着自己的舌尖向虫小蝶源源不断地流去，这股恐怖的力量来的十分诡异！万青山慌忙地想撤走舌头，但是他的瞳孔陡然一缩，心下泛起一阵寒意！原来，他的舌尖竟然牢牢地粘在了小虫子脖颈上。万青山暗自惊恐，他急运内力想挣开虫小蝶，但是舌尖早已麻痹了！长长的舌头现在剧颤不已！而且他愈想锁住内力，他的内力却愈是流逝加快！

The "soul-capturing lamp" was floating in the air, and the green light in the teaching field was strong. Almost everyone's eyes were attracted to it without blinking.
But that cry was too late after all. The ghost lantern's techniques were weird and his attacks were swift. Driven by his magic, the "soul-capturing lamp" became more and more dazzling. The green light shone brightly, making the teaching field as dazzling and magical as a gem!
Gui Deng raised his eyes and looked down. The imperial guards on the periphery had quietly dispersed, and the eyes of everyone on the teaching field were filled with strange green, and they were staring straight at the "soul-capturing lamp".
The ghost lamp gently waved its long sleeves, and the "soul-capturing lamp" flew to his hand and stood in his palm.
He stretched out his withered right hand, slowly pointed it straight at Gui Yi's black cloak. Then he curled up his middle finger and recited silently: "Ghost lamps, spiritual creatures, grace and holy light, covered with splendor, don't be invaded by anything!"
Slowly, a little green will-o'-the-wisp floated from the black cloak, followed by two, then three, more and more, slowly rising, moving, and heading straight towards the "Soul Capture Lamp"! As the last bit of will-o'-the-wisp floated into the "soul-taking lamp", the ghost lamp said in a deep voice: "Come out, are you okay?"
As Gui Deng finished speaking, the black cloak came to life again and slowly expanded. Under the swarthy veil, those big white eyes lit up like bright lights and ignited again!
"The master of the 'Ancient Sword Alliance' is here, which surprises me! If you hadn't appeared in time, offered the 'Soul Capture Lamp' and used the 'Ghost Fire Green Light' to protect me, that sword would have almost killed me!" Gui Yi was still frightened.
"That old immortal eunuch has delayed me for too long! Now all the guards and imperial guards have withdrawn! It's time to take action!" Gui Deng paused, pointed at the stunned people in the audience and said, "No one is left?"
"Leave no one behind!" Gui Yi said coldly.
There are beautiful pavilions, underground passages, and dim candlelight.
A man wearing a veil covering his nose and mouth and wearing a fortune teller's coat hurried in. Wan Qingshan frowned and asked, "What happened?"
"Brother, as you expected, the people from Netherworld Ghost Mansion are massacring heroes in the teaching field!" the visitor said breathlessly.
"So, where is my uncle? Is he okay?" Wan Qingcheng asked anxiously. "Uncle Yuanbo, he...he has been beaten to death by the ghost-clothed guards!" "What?" Wanqingcheng looked in disbelief.
"Hey, one general's success is worth tens of thousands. My uncle must die this time! You just need to remember today's revenge. When you climb to the top of the martial arts world and lead the world's heroes, it will not be too late to retaliate!" Wan Qingshan turned his back with an indifferent expression.
But Wanqingcheng glanced at his brother's back with an incredulous look. His eyes were wandering, and his mind was filled with thoughts: Is my brother still the same brother as before? Over the past ten years of hard work in the world, the kind, sensible, and filial brother has become so ruthless, cold-blooded, and insidious!
"Then..." Wan Qingshan stroked his beard and then asked: "Have the people from the Butterfly Sect shown up?"
"No. From the beginning to now, it hasn't appeared at all." The fortune teller shook his head.
"Okay!" Wan Qingshan paused, then took Wan Qingcheng's hand and walked towards the fortune teller. I just heard him say in a deep voice: "God bless, you and I have the best relationship in the 'Blood Demon Sect'. After I leave, my brother will be entrusted to you!"
"Brother, there is no need to say more. You and I have been on the run for many years. We cherish each other and feel like brothers. Moreover, all the brothers respect you very much. There are some things you don't need to tell me personally!" Tianyou's eyes were filled with tears and his eyes were burning. Wan Qingshan patted him on the shoulder and said, "Good brother! Act as planned!"
Tianyou quickly took off the fortune teller's coat, handed it to Wan Qingshan, and then said in a choked voice: "Brother! Let's go... please...!" Before he could finish speaking, Tianyou's voice was already trembling.
Wan Qingshan held his shoulders tightly with both hands and interrupted him.His words: "Take care!" After hearing this, Tianyou stared blankly at this elder brother who had shared the joys and sorrows with him, then quickly turned his head, hid his tears, and left Wanqing City silently.
In the cold secret passage, only Wanjin King, who had been dead for many days, was left, Chong Xiaodie who was unconscious, and Wan Qingshan with tears in his eyes!
"Uh!" Chong Xiaodie, who was feeling tight in his chest, finally let out a breath and slowly got up. He rubbed his groggy eyes and looked around.
There are not too many decorations in the tunnel, only an incense table, a coffin, two wicker chairs, and two flickering candles. However, it seems to be even colder in the tunnel! The walls of the cave were covered with ice crystals, a thin layer like a layer of milk. And the big cloud of white air exhaled between breaths will make people feel a little bit of pain when touching the tip of the nose. The cold tunnel couldn't hold any warmth. From time to time, a bit of cold wind blew through, and the bone-eroding coldness became more prevalent, and could even freeze the air in the entire tunnel!
"Little Guitou, are you awake?" Wan Qingshan restrained his sadness, smiled strangely at Chong Xiaodie, then slowly walked towards Chong Xiaodie with his long tongue hanging out.
"Who are you? You...what are you going to do?" That tongue was as long as an evil spirit and as red as blood, sending shivers down Chong Xiaodie's spine! He shivered and tried to move his body backward.
However, before Chong Xiaodie could struggle, Wan Qingshan pounced on him and bit his neck. "Chi!" A line of blood spurted out.
A wave of warmth poured into Wanqingshan's throat like nectar, and bursts of refreshing and graceful feeling came from the base of his tongue. That feeling went straight to the whole body! He sucked greedily, while Chong Xiaodie twisted her body feebly, pressing her two small fists directly against Wan Qingshan's chest, trying her best to push him away.
Wanqingshan is the "Black Bat Elder" of the Butterfly Sect. Because of practicing the "Exotic Butterfly Technique", he has become neither human nor ghost like the "Fish and Snake Elders". His spine was damaged, his menstrual blood was clogged, and he had to drink human blood from time to time. The intermediate secret of "Alien Butterfly Technique", when "using the body to create an illusion", the "Fish and Snake Elders" refined fish and snakes. What he refined was the "Black Bat". Its moves and footwork were quite similar to those of bats, so he was called the "Elder Black Bat".
However, he didn't realize that the line of blood just sprayed directly into the brocade box he put aside, and the brocade box contained the "White Jade Guanyin"!
The crystal clear, cold treasure seemed to feel the warmth of the blood and smell the fishy smell of the blood. It slowly started to shake and screamed. On the side, Wanqingshan, who was extremely lustful and sucked passionately, was enjoying the fragrance of virgin blood without noticing it at all!

He didn't know what it was and wanted to turn his head to see, but the soreness and numbness in his neck made him miserable and he had no time to care!
With the loss of blood, Chong Xiaodie's eyes slowly lost their light, and his consciousness began to become blurred and chaotic. He only knew two things. His blood was flowing continuously into Wanqing Mountain Pass, and he was walking towards death step by step! His hands drooped down weakly, and his thoughts wandered beyond the sky.
But Wan Qingshan, who was sucking greedily on the side, had no intention of letting go. Suddenly, he felt something was wrong, paused, and then leaned forward to suck again. But this time, as soon as he touched Chong Xiaodie's neck, he suddenly felt a strange cold air! He frowned and continued sucking, but something strange happened!
Wan Qingshan suddenly found that his inner energy was flowing continuously towards Chong Xiaodie with the tip of his tongue. This terrifying forceThe measurement is very strange! Wan Qingshan hurriedly tried to remove his tongue, but his pupils suddenly shrank, and a chill filled his heart! It turned out that the tip of his tongue was firmly stuck on the little insect's neck. Wan Qingshan was secretly frightened. He used his inner strength to break away from Chong Xiaodie, but the tip of his tongue was already paralyzed! The long tongue is trembling now! And the more he tried to lock in his internal power, the faster his internal power evaporated!
